chars.GIRL: the DAUGHTER: a young woman about 20 wearing round thin black-framed glasses, a mustard-yellow headscarf, a long faded light-blue work tunic over black trousers and pink rubber cleaning gloves.
chars.MOM: the CLEANING LADY: a middle-aged woman in a navy-blue cleaning smock with a white headscarf and green rubber gloves.
chars.AMINE: the STUDENT: a young man wearing a cream cable-knit sweater, light beige chino trousers, white sneakers and a brown leather backpack.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the end of a bright Moroccan college corridor (tiled floor, classroom doors, notice board), the daughter is caught mid-act carrying a heavy grey plastic bucket full of water with both hands and a mop under her arm, head-to-waist framing, face visible, busy and focused. Morning light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the college corridor the cleaning lady mops the tiled floor while her daughter beside her wrings a mop into the bucket, both working hard, students' classroom doors behind them. Medium shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The daughter, mopping the corridor floor, looks up shyly through her glasses; in the background the student walks past with his backpack without noticing her, looking at his phone. She is in the foreground center, he is smaller behind.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A corridor corner in the college: the student walks quickly toward a classroom door holding a notebook, while just around the corner the daughter is bent down lifting the full bucket of water, neither sees the other coming. Tense comic moment, both visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Comic accident in the college corridor: the startled daughter jumps back and the bucket of water splashes all over the student's beige trousers; he freezes with arms raised and a shocked open mouth, she covers her mouth with a gloved hand, eyes wide behind her glasses. Water splash on the floor.
